String vegenir_verschluesseln(String t, String s) {
  String n = "";
  t = t.toUpperCase();
  s = s.toUpperCase();
  int j = -1;
  for (int i = 0; i<t.length(); i++) {
    j += 1;
    if (j >= s.length()) {
      j = 0;
    }
    int x = s.charAt(j)-65;
    char c = (char) (t.charAt(i)+x);
    if (c > 90) {
      c -= 26;
    }
    n+=c;
  }
  return n;
}

String vegenir_entschluesseln(String t, String s) {
  String n = "";
  t = t.toUpperCase();
  s = s.toUpperCase();
  int j = -1;
  for (int i = 0; i<t.length(); i++) {
    j += 1;
    if (j >= s.length()) {
      j = 0;
    }
    int x = s.charAt(j)-65;
    char c = (char) (t.charAt(i)-x);
    if (c < 65) {
      c += 26;
    }
    n+=c;
  }
  return n;
}

void setup() {
  String text = "";
  String schluessel = "MAUS";
  println(vegenir_entschluesseln(text, schluessel));
  exit();
}
